title: Auto Loans: APR Recorded When Autopay Ends
content:
This rule gives the APR and the discount list written on an Auto Loans account when its autopay enrollment is cancelled.

## Rule

Where the product withdraws the autopay discount on cancellation, the only discount the loan retains is the confirmed relationship discount, limited to the product's combined discount limit. The new APR is the undiscounted rate less that retained discount. Where the product does not withdraw the autopay discount on cancellation, the APR on the loan's record carries over unchanged.

Either way, a figure that falls below the product's APR floor is replaced by the floor, and the rate is stated to two decimals.

The discount list is written as relationship when the relationship discount is retained and as none when it is not. Where the product does not withdraw the autopay discount on cancellation, the list stays as recorded.

## Condition, judgement, outcome

| Product withdraws autopay discount | Relationship discount confirmed | APR written | Discount list written |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | undiscounted rate less the relationship discount (within the limit), floor applied | relationship |
| yes | no | undiscounted rate, floor applied | none |
| no | either | recorded APR unchanged, floor applied | unchanged |

## Examples (hypothetical rates and discount sizes)

- Undiscounted rate 7.30, relationship discount confirmed at a hypothetical 0.30, floor 4.00: the APR written is 7.00 and the list reads relationship.
- Undiscounted rate 7.30, no relationship discount: the APR written is 7.30 and the list reads none.
- Undiscounted rate 4.10, relationship discount 0.30, floor 4.00: 3.80 falls below the floor, so 4.00 is written.
